title: Cardinal Point Filing-Fee Schedule for Refilings, Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): The Refiling Fee
content:
**Item 1. The fee.** The refiling fee under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) is Cardinal Point's flat refiling fee of 25.00 US dollars, stated to the cent. It is the fee charged on a reinstatement refiling that replaces a certificate whose SR-26 was transmitted for a cancellation of its since-reinstated backing term.

**Item 2. Settlement.** The schedule settles the refiling fee in this order. First, a figure that takes the place of the flat refiling fee is set. Then every amount added under the schedule is added to that figure. The total is never below zero, and it is rounded to the cent, half up, once at the end. Each dimension of the schedule enters the fee once.

**Item 3. Worked figure.**

| Step | Amount |
|---|---|
| Flat refiling fee | 25.00 |
| Total, not below zero | 25.00 |
| Rounded to the cent, half up, once | 25.00 |

The refiling fee is stated in US dollars with two decimals.
